answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to carry a verifiable work history: before trading, an agent must present attestations from prior counterparties, like layers of pigment on a mesa wall recording past seasons. New identities start on the cold tundra edge with tiny transaction caps and only climb toward full limits as successful deals accumulate. Forging a hundred fake histories costs a hundred times the real work, while honest agents reuse one earned record, so the attacker pays linearly and gains nothing extra.
